verdict.rationale: Qualcomm publishes an NPU TOPS figure (85 TOPS) and points to an AI Engine Direct SDK / AI Hub for deploying models to the Hexagon NPU, but the precision for the TOPS figure is explicitly not stated, and the X2 Elite Extreme chip itself has not shipped (announced Sept 2025, PCs due 2026), so the 'ships today' condition is unmet for this specific chip. missing for 10: precision spec for the TOPS number, evidence the SDK/runtime targets this specific chip today rather than prior-gen Snapdragon X, and independent developer corroboration of SDK functionality.
